source.text:
# Let-polymorphism + monomorphization. `dup` is used at two distinct types, so
# inference specializes it into two clones. The post-channelize (pre-inference)
# body `(x, x)` carries a hole; downstream it resolves to a *set* of tuple types
# (Int and Bool) — the B5 hole->downstream-type stitch, and the mono fan-out
# that makes `paneLinks` non-empty.
dup = \x -> (x, x)
a = dup(1)
b = dup(2 == 2)
a
